tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient measurements reveal a steep supercritical decline consistent with the recalled avalanche mechanism. The earlier attempts failed at Python parsing, so they did not test the model. This submission numerically fits the coefficients and threshold before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither directly represents the sharp sink-gradient threshold and subsequent negative response observed in the paid probe.
The eight observations constrain the recalled five-parameter avalanche law; fresh confirmation is more informative than another trajectory probe.
It is irrelevant to identifying the observed threshold mechanism.
